messages:
maya: kicking off intake for a customer trial with a new Mistral-7B-v2 variant, want to sanity-check onboarding + prompt templates before we run quant. target: low-latency chat with tool calling.

luca: nice — quick intake checklist: 1) customer workload samples 2) target SLOs (p95 120ms?) 3) hardware target (A10G vs H100) 4) must-have evals + prompt set link. pinged intake form https://tiny.redwood/intake (fill hw + throughput). :white_check_mark:

emily: for quant experiments I suggest: do a shallow sweep q8_0 -> q4_0 -> q4_1 on a dev pool first. run with seq=1024 then a longer run at 2048. watch for BLEU/ROUGE drop and alignment regressions. calibration note: always run KL-divergence against fp16 baseline.

jason: prompt formatting note: our chat templates should include an explicit output schema and a short system instruction to avoid hallucinated fields. example: ```
"system": "You are an assistant. Always respond with JSON matching the schema. If unsure, respond with {\"error\": \"unknown\"}.",
"user_template": "<user_message>\nReturn JSON: {\"answer\":string,\"sources\": [string], \"tool_calls\": [object]}"
```
Keep the schema minimal so quant doesn't change tokenization too much.

sasha-bot: smoke-run finished on dev-q8 pool (run id r-1795): ppl + latency summary -> ppl_fp16: 2.4, ppl_q8: 2.6 (+8%), median latency_fp16: 95ms, median latency_q8: 72ms, 99th latency_q8: 210ms. small deg in ppl, big wins in latency. attached logs to build.

maya: good — two immediate asks: (A) tool-calling + structured output test, (B) regression guardrails. For A, here's a minimal tool-calling chat example we should include in integration tests:
```json
{
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"You are a structured assistant. Only call tools when necessary and return final JSON."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Find the top 3 docs about rate limits and return as JSON with fields title, url."}
  ],
  "tools": ["search", "kb_read"],
  "expected_output_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"results":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string"},"url":{"type":"string"}}}}}
}
```
This ensures the model returns parsed objects (no extra prose).

luca: for B, propose regression pipelines: baseline fp16 + q8 nightly eval on canary traffic (5% rollout). if metric drop > 2% BLEU or > 5% user-satisfaction we auto rollback. Add alerts in console.

emily: I'll take the quant sweep tickets. need the eval suite + seeds. putting a gist with 200 prompts (dev + adversarial) in the intake doc. Also recommend adding a prompt-normalization step: strip trailing whitespace, unify punctuation, explicit newline separators. That reduced noise in prior runs.

jason: API integration tidbits: use model aliasing so customers can pin variants, e.g. model = "mistral-7b-v2:q8". example curl for structured output test:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"mistral-7b-v2:q8","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You must return JSON (no extra text)."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize..."}],"schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"answer":{"type":"string"}}}}'
```
Note: our SDK will validate the top-level JSON schema before returning to the app.

sasha-bot: benchmark-compare job 1795-compare complete: fp16 vs q8 vs q4_0 across eval set (200 prompts). metrics csv: latency_kpis, exact_match, BLEU. quick diff: exact_match change q8:-1.2%, q4_0:-4.9%. attaching URL to job results in console.

maya: perfect — next steps: emily runs quant sweep (assign ticket), jason adds the chat template + schema to the integration tests, luca wires canary/rollback rules in the rollout config, I'll file the regression alert thresholds. can everyone drop a one-line status in this thread when done? :pray:

emily: started ticket #ENG-ML-4721, will update when q8 dev sweep completes.

jason: added schema test to CI under chat_integration/test_structured_output.py, PR incoming.

luca: rollout policy updated, canary = 5%, auto-rollback condition added.

maya: thanks all — keeping this thread as the canonical checklist for this intake. closing once emily posts final smoke metrics and jason's PR merges. :rocket:
